caseName: Electric Storage Battery Co. v. Shimadzu
caseNameFull: Electric Storage Battery Co. v. Shimadzu

opinions.text:
The opinion is amended by striking out the word “them” at the end of the first full paragraph on page 11, and substituting “the claims in suit”; and by striking out the words “invalidity of” in the next to the last line of the opinion and substituting therefor the words “dismissal as to.” The petitions for rehearing are denied.

Reported as amended, ante, p. 5.
